prior_summary: Diffuse every Cartesian command simultaneously in drawer and block frames, then use fresh drawer stability and measured finger width to route drawer contact through target_pose and released departure through object_pose.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when the tunnel block is displaced, late handoff must remain block-relative, and both target_pose and object_pose are reliable with phase order consistent with approach-pull-release.
termination_guidance: Hand off once the object route is active, the drawer stays fully open/stable, fingers remain open, and the arm has clearance in the shared block-relative departure corridor.
limitations: The hard causal route can be wrong under unseen phase order or noisy anchors. Nineteen-dimensional redundant diffusion is harder, and large anchor displacements remain subject to reachability and collision constraints.
